claims.scope: injectAndCall balance injection and arbitrary external call on the router contract

preconditions.text: The router contract holds ETH or ERC20 tokens (leftovers, accidental transfers, or intermediate balances).; injectAndCall is declared public and lacks any access-control or onlyDelegatecall guard, even though it assumes delegated wallet context.; The caller can supply a caller-chosen target and calldata to injectAndCall.

safety.text: injectAndCall, which operates on address(this) balances for delegated wallet context, should only execute in a delegated call context (guarded like onlyDelegatecall), so direct calls cannot spend the router's own balances.
